Diphenoxylate & Loperamide (Dextromethorphan HBr, PrilosecOTC)
Recently a 'relative' (I use that term lightly for this person) has had a bad string of luck and had to stay in the hospital for several weeks. Now, the neighborhood, being what junkies we are now-a-days, the good stuff was long gone before I got to raid the leftovers. Good stuff I mean 30MG Oxy's, .25MG Halcions, 1MG Lorazepam, you get the idea.
While my search yielded fair results (hey, I got a half-pint of Lean (Codeine/Promethazine syrup) and a full bottle of 75MG Lyrica's (Pregabalin).) I like Lyrica, I've used the 50MG's quite a bit for opioid potentiation or just for a relaxing time (I'd call it Xanax JR. or something along those lines).
Anyway, I also stumbled upon two full bottles of Diphenoxylate/Atropine (f* atropine btw) which got my opiate receptors firing a little bit. This would be the second occasion I've come across this strangely rare chemical relative of the great Demerol (Meperidine). Last time, due to the atropine, I worked my way up. I only had about 20 the last time so my experiences were limited. This time I had a good 40, give or take a few. Well, I got them last night and it's been about 14 hours and I only have two left.
Yes, you read right opiophiliacs, 38 of these little bad boys, all up the snoot (over the past 12-14 hours anyway), with 10MG of these Diphie's at a time (Which we call 'em for short round here, when and if we do =). I suppose its because I've read that intranasal use of Loperamide helps the chemical by-pass the B/B/B a little bit easier. I would assume the same for Diphenoxylate, only much better! And I've had good results. I've used Demerol and every other common opioid/ate out there and this has properties and effects unlike others, although may be comparable to milder synthetics such as Propoxyphene or Demerol.
In an attempt to improve the experience as much as possible without other opioids available, I dropped a handful of Imodium's to aid in Mu-Receptor agonism. With Loperamide, I always get positive effects (other then extra constipation of course). Hey, it don't hurt anything right? It's a full agonist, so of course its going to increase opiate-like effects, even if minimally.
I also took a prilosec -1 hour before I snorted the first 10MG rail of the day. Then I bumped it up to 20MG a toot, a little powdery and a very slight burn, but otherwise not bad. I find my withdrawals have disappeared. I notice a slight buzz when tooting. I had no other opiate in my system other then Dextromethorphan (also for potentiation). The Prilosec aided in absorption and enhanced the duration of the high, at least it seems to have as it does with all/most other opiates/oids.
